meta.label: Individual Cerebras API key
meta.description: Let every DSS user store their own Cerebras key, so Cerebras rate limits and billing attribute per user. Users create a key at https://cloud.cerebras.ai.

params.name: api_key
params.label: Your Cerebras API key
params.description: Each user fills this in under Profile and settings > Credentials > Plugins. Not mandatory here: the admin creates the preset empty, and users supply their own key afterwards.
